name: Notion
summary: Search, read and write your workspace.
description: Notion's hosted server lets the agent search the workspace, read pages and databases, and create or edit pages. It reaches exactly what your Notion account can see.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.notion.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
